technique_name: Write a 100-word description of a bustling city street scene.
description: The typical city street scene is a flurry of activity. People of all ages and backgrounds are rushing from place to place, their faces illuminated by pocket screens, their strides swift and purposeful. Horns blare in the distance, and on occasion, the rumble of a bus or the screech of a train car echo through the air.
